results.title: Protect College Sports Act gains Senate approval in bipartisan vote
results.description: The Protect College Sports Act took its next step forward on Monday, with the Senate voting overwhelmingly 77-22 in favor of the proposed federal legislation reforming college athletics.

results.title: Afghanistan summons Pakistani envoy, lodges strong protest over “cross-border infiltration” in Nuristan
results.description: Kabul [Afghanistan], September 30 (ANI): The Ministry of International Affairs of Afghanistan on Tuesday (native time) summoned the Cost d’Affaires of the Pakistani Embassy in Kabul to lodge a powerful letter of protest in opposition to the “infiltration of damaging armed parts throughout the Durand Line into Istiqlal in Nuristan.” In an announcement posted on […] The post Afghanistan summons Pakistani envoy, lodges strong protest over “cross-border infiltration” in Nuristan appeared first on Asia Today .

results.title: Seattle police leadership promises ‘proactive’ efforts on gun violence
results.description: Seattle’s interim police chief Andre Sayles says he wants to staff up "proactive" gun violence investigations and enforcement. But Sayles says he has to balance those efforts with keeping patrol officers on the streets. The president of the Seattle Police Officers Guild is applauding the move and says the union will be a "willing participant" in these efforts.

results.title: Migrant Children Facing Court Alone: Lapsed Federal Contracts Left Thousands Unrepresented Before Judge
results.description: A 13-year-old was ordered removed without a lawyer in Texas. Here is how funding gaps left migrant children facing U.S. immigration judges alone.

results.title: Prime Minister of Saint Vincent and Grenadines meets Minister of State at Ministry of Foreign Affairs
results.description:
Kingstown: Prime Minister of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines HE Godwin Friday met in Kingstown on Tuesday with Minister of State at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs HE Dr. Mohammed bin Abdulaziz bin Saleh Al Khulaifi.

During the meeting, both sides discussed cooperation between the two countries and ways to deepen and expand it, as well as the latest developments in Latin America and several issues of common interest.

HE the Minister of State at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs stressed the importance of strengthening shared international efforts to help consolidate security and stability in Latin America.
HE Director General of the Qatar Fund for Development Fahad bin Hamad Al Sulaiti attended the meeting.
